summary: This study is comparing two different fasting methods for adults taking certain diabetes and weight loss medications who need an upper endoscopy camera test of the upper digestive tract. Participants will be put into one of two groups: one group follows a 24-hour clear liquid diet, while the other follows a standard fasting routine. The goal is to see which method leaves the stomach clearer before the camera test. The Portuguese Oncology Institute, Coimbra is sponsoring the study, which plans to enroll 250 people.
